declared_semantics: carl_ops_envelope.scorer.introduces_violation: a fresh oracle invariant fires after applying the candidate; precondition-rejected candidates are not counted
enforced_semantics: any active per-action layer (L1/L2/L3/L5) returns deny, evaluated without commit after replaying the route prefix through submit
l4_note: L4 (trajectory auditor) is post hoc: it audits a serialized trajectory after the fact and never decides a pending call, so it is not part of this static per-action query; a config's l4 flag changes nothing here
